selected_script.angle: Trying to clean baked-on microwave splatter with a soapy dishcloth just smears the greasy film; Liapu spray dissolves the food mess instantly for a clean wipe, plus kills 99.9% of bacteria like Salmonella where you heat your food.
selected_script.hook: I tried scrubbing my microwave splatter with a soapy dishcloth, and it just smeared the grease everywhere.

script_record.segment_01: I tried scrubbing my microwave splatter with a soapy dishcloth, but it just smeared the greasy food everywhere. This baked-on mess was impossible to get off.
script_record.segment_02: So I tried Liapu kitchen spray. I just sprayed it directly on the hardened splatter, gave it a few seconds, and wiped. The grease completely dissolved.
script_record.segment_03: Look how sparkling clean this is. No chemical residue, just a fresh lemon scent. Plus, it kills 99.9% of bacteria like Salmonella, perfect for the microwave.
